title: Swift Rapid NGS Part 2 - Adaptase
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol is part two of a five-part series to perform Swift Biosciences Rapid NGS Library Prep kit. The protocol is split in such a way so as to allow for the option to run between the Rapid and Standard versions of the kit. Please find all linked parts of the protocol below: Links: * [Swift NGS Part 1 - Reverse Transcription and SPRI Cleanup](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/6a93a2) * [Swift Rapid NGS Part 3 - Extension, SPRI, and Ligation](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/6a93a2-part3) * [Swift Rapid NGS Part 4 - SPRI Clean](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/6a93a2-part4) * [Swift Rapid NGS Part 5 - Indexing and SPRI Clean](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/6a93a2-part5) Part two of this protocol is divided into the following methods for 8, 16, or 24 samples: * Make Adaptase Mastermix * Run Thermocycler Profile * Add Adaptase Mastermix Explanation of complex parameters below: * `Number of Samples`: Specify the number of samples that will be processed. * `Adaptase Mastermix Overage Percent (0-10%)`: Specify the percent overage of Reverse Transcription Mastermix to make and ultimately add to samples. * `Opentrons 96 Tip Rack 20ul Tip Type`: Specify whether filter or non-filter 20ul tips will be employed. * `P300 Multi GEN2 Mount`: Specify which mount (left or right) to load the P300 multi channel pipette. * `P20 Single GEN2 Mount`: Specify which mount (left or right) to load the P20 single channel pipette. ---
Adaptase mastermix is made on ice (4C)
User moves samples to ice for 4 minutes
Adaptase mastermix is added to samples

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Set the number of samples to be processed, specify the Adaptase Mastermix overage percent (0‑10 %), choose the Opentrons 96‑tip rack 20 µL tip type (filter or non‑filter), and load the P300 multi‑channel GEN2 pipette on the indicated mount (left or right) and the P20 single‑channel GEN2 pipette on its indicated mount.

steps.title: Prepare Adaptase Mastermix on ice
steps.instruction: On ice (4 °C), assemble the Adaptase Mastermix using the calculated volume that includes the specified overage percent, then vortex the tube to ensure thorough mixing.

steps.title: Run first thermocycler profile
steps.instruction: Place the samples in the thermocycler and run the prescribed Adaptase thermocycler profile.

steps.title: Incubate samples on ice
steps.instruction: Transfer the tubes to ice and incubate for 4 minutes.

steps.title: Add Adaptase Mastermix to samples
steps.instruction: Using the selected 20 µL tips, add the prepared Adaptase Mastermix to each sample.

steps.title: Run second thermocycler profile
steps.instruction: Return the samples to the thermocycler and run the second Adaptase thermocycler profile.

steps.title: Cool samples to 4 °C
steps.instruction: After the thermocycler run, bring the samples back down to 4 °C (e.g., place on ice) so they are ready for the extension step.
